does: Sends a reply back once when it names a PR, issue or ticket without a link, so every reference can be opened.

children.does: Finds PR numbers such as #123 or PR 123.
Finds issues such as owner/repo#123 or issue 123.
Finds ticket ids such as APP-42.
Only these ticket prefixes count, such as APP. When the list is empty, every upper-case prefix counts.
Prefixes that are never tickets, such as UTF in UTF-8.
